purpose: The link lines of a Plan card (Part of, Sub-functions, Function of Value, Value of Function, Solution of, Solutions and Part of System), each shown by the linked records' live tags, with the host doing every read, cache and write.
namedChanges: `useQueryClient()` is `usePlanTagLinksHost()` (a private hook reading `PlanTagLinksHostContext`, throwing an error that names the provider when there is none), placed after `useCardMode()` (in `PlanSubFunctions`, which has none, where the `useQueryClient()` stood is the first line). `writeLink`, `writeMeasures` and `writeSolutionOf` take `host` where they took `qc`. The host is typed with its optional writers read as present (`Required<PlanTagLinksHost>`) in one place, the private hook; each component's added read-only line is what keeps a missing writer from being reached.

Each call that reached outside the unit is the host member of the same name, with the same arguments but for `qc`: `useRecords`, `useRelations`, `usePlanFind`, `invalidatePlanFind`, `invalidatePlanSearch`, `liveRow`, `ensureEtagUnchanged`, `applyPatch`, `storePlanRow`, `dropPlanFind`, `prependPlanFind`, `putRecordInCaches`, `resolveType`, `typeUriForVaultNamespace`, `memberEntityUri`, `readRecord` (also the third argument of `wouldLoop`), `patchRecord`, `createRecord`, `writePairRelation`, `endRelation`, and `<ConnectedCreateDialog>` as `<host.ConnectedCreateDialog>`. `qc.setQueryData(planRecordKey(updated.id, updated.entityUri), updated)` is `host.setPlanRecord(updated.id, updated.entityUri, updated)`. In `writeSolutionOf`, `const key = relationsKey(...)` is dropped, `qc.getQueryData<RecordRelation[]>(key)` is `host.getRelations(viewing.id, viewing.entityUri)` and `qc.setQueryData(key, [...])` is `host.setRelations(viewing.id, viewing.entityUri, [...])`; in the two remove handlers `qc.setQueryData<RecordRelation[]>(relationsKey(record.id, record.entityUri ?? null), updater)` is `host.setRelations(record.id, record.entityUri ?? null, updater)`.

`useCreateRecord(planVault)` is `(host.useCreateRecord ?? useNoCreate)(planVault)`: the hook is called on every render in the same place; `useNoCreate` is a private stand-in whose `mutateAsync` rejects, never reached because the component is then read-only.

One added line per component with a writer: `canEdit = canEdit && … !== undefined;` (see "What the host must supply"). It is the only added statement in `PlanPartOf`, `PlanFunctionOfValue`, `PlanValueOfFunction`, `PlanSolutionOf` and `PlanSolutions`. `PlanPartOfSystem` has no such line; its one change is in the condition of the create button: `search.canCreate ? (` is `search.canCreate && host.ConnectedCreateDialog !== undefined ? (`, so a host without the dialog is not offered "Create System" (picking and clearing an existing system are unchanged).

The seven components were exported in the source and still are; `writeLink`, `writeMeasures`, `writeSolutionOf`, `SolutionChips`, `measuredAddresses`, `tagFor` and `SOFTWARE_SYSTEM_OPTION` stay private, as in the source.

library.title: Link lines (Part of, Sub-functions, Solution of)
library.note: Seven link lines of a Plan card; the picker alone is plan-tag-picker, the pure model plan-links-model.
